name: Order Monitor – Order Minimum/Maximum, Order Limit, Min and Max Quantity for WooCommerce
author: Iqbal Hossain

sections.description:
The Order Monitor plugin allows you to impose custom restrictions on WooCommerce orders, including:

  • Time-Based Restrictions: Prevents users from placing an order or adding items to the cart within a specified time window.
  • Order Limitations: Restricts users to a maximum number of orders within a given period.

Features

  • Restrict users from adding items to the cart within a set time period after their last order.
  • Limit the total number of orders a user can place.
  • Easy-to-use settings page for customizing restrictions.
  • Custom product meta fields for more advanced product validation.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the order-monitor folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
